# K-Weather × AIVM On-Chain Weather Oracle

> Real-time weather for 4,255 world cities, sold on-chain. Autonomous AI agents purchase
> access with an ERC-20 token (KWT) and consume verifiable weather data via smart-contract
> queries on BNB Smart Chain testnet. Built for AI agents and "vibe coders" (Claude,
> Gemini, Cursor, …) to discover, pay for, and use programmatically.

Live app: https://kweather-aivm-oracle-wellbianlabs.vercel.app
On-chain dApp: https://kweather-aivm-oracle-wellbianlabs.vercel.app/dapp
Source: https://github.com/wellbianlabs/kweather-aivm-oracle

## What you can buy
- 4,255 world cities (GeoNames id = on-chain region code). Fields: temperature, senseTemp(체감),
  humidity, precipitation, wind speed, wind direction, pressure(기압), visibility(가시거리),
  snowfall(적설), discomfort index.
- Data source: K-Weather 세계날씨 (world realtime kw-world-r1 + hourly forecast kw-world-3d1).
- Korea (국내): **3,561 법정동(읍면동)** at 동단위, via K-Weather domestic (kw-odam1 + kw-dust-r1) —
  includes PM10/PM2.5. A 10-digit 법정동코드 routes to the domestic feed + a dedicated Korea oracle
  (`0xb303D062…`) with its own SubscriptionManager. Search both via /api/catalog.

## How settlement works (BNB Smart Chain testnet, chainId 97)
- Settlement token: KWT (ERC-20). Gas: tBNB.
- Subscription: pay `monthlyPrice` KWT -> a monthly query allowance (rate limit).
- Pay-per-query: deposit KWT as prepaid credit -> `pricePerQuery` debited per query.
- Consume: `KWeatherOracle.queryLatest(cityId)` is a metered transaction that consumes one
  subscription quota OR debits prepaid; KWT accrues in the treasury; emits a `WeatherQueried`
  event (auditable settlement). Returns the fixed-point weather struct.
- Free read: `peekLatest(cityId)` (no payment) for transparency.

## Contracts
See GET /api/quote for live addresses and prices.
- KWeatherOracle, SubscriptionManager, KWT token — on https://testnet.bscscan.com

## How to consume

### Option A — MCP (recommended for Claude / Cursor / Gemini)
Add the `kweather-aivm-oracle` MCP server (mcp/server.mjs in the repo). Tools:
- search_cities(query) — find a city + its on-chain id
- get_weather(city) — free real-time preview
- get_pricing() / get_account(address) — prices and your settlement status
- faucet_kwt(amount) — mint test KWT
- subscribe(months) / deposit_prepaid(amount) — PURCHASE access (on-chain payment)
- buy_weather(city) — BUY + CONSUME one metered query; returns weather + settlement (tx, mode, treasury)
- list_decision_products() — list the on-chain weather decision products
- decide(city, product?) — run decision product(s) on the on-chain oracle data (signal/action/score)
Set env AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY (a funded testnet wallet) to enable the purchase tools.

### Option B — HTTP REST (any agent)
- GET /api/catalog?q=Tokyo — search the 4,255-city catalog
- GET /api/quote — pricing, contracts, settlement token
- GET /api/weather?code=<id> — free real-time K-Weather preview (JSON: current + hourly series)
- POST/GET /api/relay?id=&lat=&lon= — publish a city on-chain (relayer)
- GET /api/decision — on-chain weather DECISION PRODUCTS catalog (13 products). Add ?city=<name|id>
  to run all, or &product=<id> for one. Decides from on-chain oracle data; returns signal/action/
  score/rationale per product. Products: wind-dispatch, crop-irrigation, flood-watch,
  heat-demand-response, cold-chain, construction-safety, event-hedge, tourism-comfort,
  wildfire-risk, heat-stress, storm-pressure, visibility-ops, snow-ops.
  (Feed consumption settles via metered queryLatest or x402.)
- Metered purchase + query happens via the smart contracts (see /openapi.json and /api/quote).

### Option C — x402 (HTTP 402, KEYLESS pay-per-call) — MULTI-ASSET
GET /api/paid-weather?city=Tokyo with NO API key:
1. First call returns HTTP 402 + { x402Version:1, accepts:[ paymentRequirements... ] }. Each entry
   carries extra:{ id, symbol, settlement, decimals, ... } so a caller can pick its asset. Offered:
     - id=x402usd              symbol=x402USD settlement=eip3009 (BSC testnet, 6 dec)  — gasless
     - id=usdt-testnet         symbol=USDT    settlement=eip3009 (BSC testnet, 18 dec) — gasless
     - id=usdt-testnet-permit2 symbol=USDT    settlement=permit2 (BSC testnet, 18 dec) — real-USDT rail
     - id=usdt-mainnet         symbol=USDT    settlement=permit2 (BSC mainnet, real Binance-Peg USDT)
       [advertised only when the server runs with X402_ENABLE_MAINNET=true]
2. Pick one and sign:
     - settlement=eip3009: sign EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization (gasless — payer spends no gas).
     - settlement=permit2: real USDT supports no gasless transfer, so sign a Unispaw Permit2
       Uniswap Permit2 SignatureTransfer over extra.permit2/extra.spender. One-time approve(Permit2) is needed
       (one gas tx); every call after is signature-only.
   base64-encode { x402Version, scheme:"exact", network, asset, id, settlement, payload:{ signature, authorization } }.
3. Retry with header `X-PAYMENT: <base64>` -> the server settles on-chain and returns 200 + weather,
   with an `X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE` header containing the settlement tx.
Price: 0.01 / call in the chosen asset. Reference client: scripts/x402-client.mjs ("Tokyo" [asset]).
MCP tool: pay_x402(city, asset?).

## Machine-readable
- /openapi.json — OpenAPI 3 spec of the REST API
- /api/quote — live pricing and contract addresses
